title: Why We Fell As Gods
body:
15 Minutes w/ The Captains · 2026-09-16

Opens [Ps 82](/bible/psalms/82) · [Josh 22](/bible/joshua/22) · [Exod 22](/bible/exodus/22) · [Gen 6](/bible/genesis/6) · [2 Sam 11](/bible/2-samuel/11) · [2 Sam 13](/bible/2-samuel/13) · [1 Kgs 11](/bible/1-kings/11) · [Deut 17](/bible/deuteronomy/17) · [Wis 6](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/6) · [Eph 2](/bible/ephesians/2) · [1 Cor 6](/bible/1-corinthians/6) · [Matt 23](/bible/matthew/23) · [Matt 19](/bible/matthew/19) · [Wis 3](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/3) · [Gal 4](/bible/galatians/4)
## Introduction *[[0:03](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=3s)]* The topic is why we fail as gods. Psalms 82 says God standeth in the congregation of the mighty and judgeth among the gods: we are the mighty, we are the gods. Captain Jeroham shows from the times we were mighty, from Genesis 6 to King David and King Solomon, how we judged unjustly, why we shall die like men, and how we get our power back. ## Scriptures Opened **[Psalms 82:1-2](/bible/psalms/82#v1)** *[[0:17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=17s)]* > [1](/bible/psalms/82#v1) God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods. > > [2](/bible/psalms/82#v2) How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah. - God standeth in the congregation of the mighty: we are the mighty. Believe it or not, black man, you are mighty in the eyes of God. We just don't know it yet. - He judgeth among the gods: we are the gods. That god is lowercase. I know you don't believe that, black man, but we are the gods. We are the mighty. **[Joshua 22:22](/bible/joshua/22#v22)** *[[0:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=52s)]* > [22](/bible/joshua/22#v22) The Lord God of gods, the Lord God of gods, he knoweth, and Israel he shall know; if it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against the Lord, (save us not this day,) - The Lord God of gods: capital G and lowercase g. He's the God of gods. So we are gods, brothers and sisters. Especially sisters, you have got to put some respect on the black man. - He knoweth, and Israel he shall know: and we shall know eventually. That's why we are bringing this topic out. - If it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against the Lord, save us not this day: if we are in sin, the prophets are saying, forget us. But if we are in righteousness, save us. **[Exodus 22:28](/bible/exodus/22#v28)** *[[2:00](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=120s)]* > [28](/bible/exodus/22#v28) Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people. - I know y'all still don't believe you're gods, but we are gods, my brothers. My black brother, you are god on this earth. - Thou shalt not revile the gods: that's the proof. Gods goes to leaders. We shall not talk evil against the ruler of your people. Nor curse the ruler of thy people. **[Psalms 82:2](/bible/psalms/82#v2)** *[[2:30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=150s)]* > [2](/bible/psalms/82#v2) How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah. - How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? God has a question to us gods on earth, the black man: how long will we judge unjustly? At what time period did we judge unjustly? **[Genesis 6:1-2](/bible/genesis/6#v1)** *[[2:50](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=170s)]* > [1](/bible/genesis/6#v1) And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them, > > [2](/bible/genesis/6#v2) That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose. - We were mighty men during the time of Genesis. The sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair, and they took them wives of all which they chose. - Now it was a sin in the eyes of God. This is us judging unjustly: we started mingling with the other nations. We are gods. We carry godly seed. We are not to mingle with other nations. - That's why he said we are mighty and we are gods, but we operate in a fleshly, heedless manner. **[2 Samuel 11:2-4](/bible/2-samuel/11#v2)** *[[3:40](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=220s)]* > [2](/bible/2-samuel/11#v2) And it came to pass in an eveningtide, that David arose from off his bed, and walked upon the roof of the king’s house: and from the roof he saw a woman washing herself; and the woman was very beautiful to look upon. > > [3](/bible/2-samuel/11#v3) And David sent and enquired after the woman. And one said, Is not this Bath–sheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite? > > [4](/bible/2-samuel/11#v4) And David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in unto him, and he lay with her; for she was purified from her uncleanness: and she returned unto her house. - Here's another example of when we were mighty upon the earth. David saw a woman washing herself, inquired after her, sent messengers and took her, and lay with her. - When we were gods on earth, when we ruled the earth under King David, we ruled for 80 years. We were mighty men, but we judged unjustly. This is another example of us doing it yet again. **[2 Samuel 11:15](/bible/2-samuel/11#v15)** *[[4:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=284s)]* > [15](/bible/2-samuel/11#v15) And he wrote in the letter, saying, Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle, and retire ye from him, that he may be smitten, and die. - Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle, that he may be smitten, and die: what did David do? He committed murder. He judged unjustly when we were mighty. **[Psalms 82:1-2](/bible/psalms/82#v1)** *[[5:05](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=305s)]* > [1](/bible/psalms/82#v1) God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods. > > [2](/bible/psalms/82#v2) How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah. - We were mighty men during the time of King David, and during the time in Genesis of the sons of God, but we judged unjustly: we mingled with the heathens and we committed murder. - He judgeth among the gods: he considers our ways. **[2 Samuel 13:1-4](/bible/2-samuel/13#v1)** *[[5:37](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=337s)]* > [1](/bible/2-samuel/13#v1) And it came to pass after this, that Absalom the son of David had a fair sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her. > > [2](/bible/2-samuel/13#v2) And Amnon was so vexed, that he fell sick for his sister Tamar; for she was a virgin; and Amnon thought it hard for him to do any thing to her. > > [3](/bible/2-samuel/13#v3) But Amnon had a friend, whose name was Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David’s brother: and Jonadab was a very subtil man. > > [4](/bible/2-samuel/13#v4) And he said unto him, Why art thou, being the king’s son, lean from day to day? wilt thou not tell me? And Amnon said unto him, I love Tamar, my brother Absalom’s sister. - Amnon, the son of David, loved his sister Tamar. Tamar is his near kin, his brother Absalom's sister. This is some evil stuff. We judged unjustly. **[2 Samuel 13:14](/bible/2-samuel/13#v14)** *[[6:36](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=396s)]* > [14](/bible/2-samuel/13#v14) Howbeit he would not hearken unto her voice: but, being stronger than she, forced her, and lay with her. - Being stronger than she, forced her, and lay with her. We are mighty and gods, but we judge unjustly. **[1 Kings 11:1-3](/bible/1-kings/11#v1)** *[[6:55](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=415s)]* > [1](/bible/1-kings/11#v1) But king Solomon loved many strange women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, and Hittites; > > [2](/bible/1-kings/11#v2) Of the nations concerning which the Lord said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love. > > [3](/bible/1-kings/11#v3) And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart. - This is when we were mighty, and I'm showing you examples of when we were mighty and judged unjustly. King Solomon loved many strange women, of the nations concerning which the Lord said, ye shall not go in to them. - Did King Solomon follow that? No. He judged unjustly. For surely they will turn away your heart after their gods, and that's exactly what they did with King Solomon. - Look how many he had: 700 wives and 300 concubines. **[Deuteronomy 17:17](/bible/deuteronomy/17#v17)** *[[8:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=487s)]* > [17](/bible/deuteronomy/17#v17) Neither shall he multiply wives to himself, that his heart turn not away: neither shall he greatly multiply to himself silver and gold. - You might say, well, he's a king, he could be able to do that. Let's find out if that's of the law. - Neither shall he multiply wives to himself: this is talking about a king amongst us. That his heart turn not away. And that's exactly what his heart did: he turned and went into all manner of evil. **[Wisdom of Solomon 6:4](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/6#v4)** *[[8:40](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=520s)]* > [4](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/6#v4) Because, being ministers of his kingdom, ye have not judged aright, nor kept the law, nor walked after the counsel of God; - Because, being ministers of his kingdom, ye have not judged aright, nor kept the law, nor walked after the counsel of God. So when we were mighty men, even until this day, we walk not according to God's counsel. **[Psalms 82:2-6](/bible/psalms/82#v2)** *[[9:05](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=545s)]* > [2](/bible/psalms/82#v2) How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah. > > [3](/bible/psalms/82#v3) Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy. > > [4](/bible/psalms/82#v4) Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked. > > [5](/bible/psalms/82#v5) They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course. > > [6](/bible/psalms/82#v6) I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High. - God is asking the question, how long will we judge unjustly when we were mighty? And accept the persons of the wicked: being a respecter of persons, seeing wickedness and not calling it evil for what it is. - Defend the poor and fatherless: we must judge rightly amongst the poor. - All the foundations of the earth are out of course. You see what God says? Because of us judging unjustly and unrighteously and not following the counsel of the Lord, all the foundations of the earth are out of course, because of the mighty men, the gods on the earth. You, black man, because we ain't right. Therefore the world is upside down. - I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High. But ye shall die like men. Why must we die like men? Verse two explains it: how long will ye judge unjustly? - Because we're not delivering the poor, taking care of the widows and the fatherless children. We are oppressing. We are whoremongering. We're committing fornication. The black community is full of the darkness and sin of this earth. They follow after the darkness of this world. **[Ephesians 2:2](/bible/ephesians/2#v2)** *[[10:54](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=654s)]* > [2](/bible/ephesians/2#v2) Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience: - Ye walked according to the course of this world: that's exactly what we're doing. We're following the courses of this world. That's the sin. That's why we are gods, but we die like men: because we went into sin. **[1 Corinthians 6:1-3](/bible/1-corinthians/6#v1)** *[[11:36](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=696s)]* > [1](/bible/1-corinthians/6#v1) Dare any of you, having a matter against another, go to law before the unjust, and not before the saints? > > [2](/bible/1-corinthians/6#v2) Do ye not know that the saints shall judge the world? and if the world shall be judged by you, are ye unworthy to judge the smallest matters? > > [3](/bible/1-corinthians/6#v3) Know ye not that we shall judge angels? how much more things that pertain to this life? - Paul was asking the question to the righteous churches that he established in Corinth: how do you go to the law, which is the scribes and Pharisees, to judge a matter, and you don't judge it amongst yourselves? - Before the unjust: the Pharisees were unjust, because they preached in hypocrisy. He's not talking about the law enforcement in your country, like the police or the government. He's talking about the scribes and Pharisees. - And not before the saints: the leaders in the church, which are the saints, those who believe in Christ and keep the commandments. - You gods on earth, you can't judge matters amongst yourselves? You have got to go to the unbelievers? **[Matthew 23:2](/bible/matthew/23#v2)** *[[12:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=761s)]* > [2](/bible/matthew/23#v2) Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat: - The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat. That's the law. That's how we know 1 Corinthians 6:1 is talking about the scribes and Pharisees. **[1 Corinthians 6:1-2](/bible/1-corinthians/6#v1)** *[[13:06](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=786s)]* > [1](/bible/1-corinthians/6#v1) Dare any of you, having a matter against another, go to law before the unjust, and not before the saints? > > [2](/bible/1-corinthians/6#v2) Do ye not know that the saints shall judge the world? and if the world shall be judged by you, are ye unworthy to judge the smallest matters? - Go to law before the unjust: the scribes and Pharisees, the law, which are hypocritical; they judge in hypocrisy. - Do ye not know that the saints shall judge the world? It says in Psalms 82 we are mighty, we are gods, and the Lord judges amongst the gods. - You might say, wait, what are we going to judge? Yes, you are god. We are the gods of this earth. That's why all the foundations of the earth are out of course: because the judges of the earth, the gods of the earth, are in the midst of sin. **[Matthew 19:28](/bible/matthew/19#v28)** *[[14:04](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=844s)]* > [28](/bible/matthew/19#v28) And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel. - Ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel. We're going to be judging the 12 tribes. **[1 Corinthians 6:2](/bible/1-corinthians/6#v2)** *[[14:28](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=868s)]* > [2](/bible/1-corinthians/6#v2) Do ye not know that the saints shall judge the world? and if the world shall be judged by you, are ye unworthy to judge the smallest matters? - The saints shall judge the world: that world represents all nations of the earth. We are going to judge the world. **[Wisdom of Solomon 3:8](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/3#v8)** *[[14:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=899s)]* > [8](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/3#v8) They shall judge the nations, and have dominion over the people, and their Lord shall reign for ever. - We are going to judge the world. That's why all the foundations of the earth are out of course. We are going to get these heathens in line, brother, believe it or not. But we have got to get ourselves in order. - They shall judge the nations, and have dominion over the people, because we are gods. But we have got to get back to our rightful throne. How do we do that? We have got to fix ourselves, guard ourselves and prepare ourselves with the law, statutes and commandments. That's where our power lies in this Bible. - And their Lord shall reign for ever: and we shall reign under Christ forever. **[1 Corinthians 6:2-3](/bible/1-corinthians/6#v2)** *[[15:38](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=938s)]* > [2](/bible/1-corinthians/6#v2) Do ye not know that the saints shall judge the world? and if the world shall be judged by you, are ye unworthy to judge the smallest matters? > > [3](/bible/1-corinthians/6#v3) Know ye not that we shall judge angels? how much more things that pertain to this life? - Paul is directing his message back to the leaders of the church of Corinth. If you know you're going to judge the world, all these heathens and all nations, how can you not judge the smallest matters? Why have you got to go to the scribes and Pharisees? - Know ye not that we shall judge angels? Who are those angels? For time's sake, Galatians 4:14. **[Galatians 4:14](/bible/galatians/4#v14)** *[[16:26](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=986s)]* > [14](/bible/galatians/4#v14) And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus. - Paul is telling the Galatians: you didn't reject me when I was going through all my trials. I was transparent and telling you what I struggled with, and you didn't go against me. - But received me as an angel of God. So it's not talking about literal angels. It's talking about the leaders. Paul is referring to himself as an angel. **[1 Corinthians 6:3](/bible/1-corinthians/6#v3)** *[[17:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=1022s)]* > [3](/bible/1-corinthians/6#v3) Know ye not that we shall judge angels? how much more things that pertain to this life? - Know ye not that we shall judge angels? Judge the leaders, judge amongst the gods. That's why we read Matthew 19:28 earlier: we shall judge among the 12 tribes of Israel. **[Psalms 82:6-8](/bible/psalms/82#v6)** *[[17:32](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=1052s)]* > [6](/bible/psalms/82#v6) I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High. > > [7](/bible/psalms/82#v7) But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes. > > [8](/bible/psalms/82#v8) Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations. - Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High. But we shall die like men, because of verse two: how long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? We have respect of persons. We didn't judge righteously. - The result of that is verse six: ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes. - Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations. So we are praying the Lord, arise and redeem Israel so we can inherit all the nations, which is this earth that belongs to the Israelites. ## In Closing *[[18:39](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0&t=1119s)]* So black man, you are the god of this earth. But we got to get our power back, and the power is the law, statutes, and commandments and the faith in Christ. This has been the 15 Minutes with the Captains. The topic is why we fail as gods. Shalom. --- [15 Minutes Index](/captains) · [Watch the full session on YouTube ↗](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhA1FXVINa0)
